analysis: The trial executed successfully but failed to improve validation: authoritative macro HR@10 was 0.5475 versus the supplied 0.580 reference, a decrease of 0.0325. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.585, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.585, Electronics 0.430, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.590. Allocated GPU cost was 401.53 seconds. Separating intact-context final prediction from corrupted-history reconstruction did not support the proposed improvement. The result does not establish why performance declined; removing final-target supervision from corrupted views may have weakened useful regularization. No held-out test results were available.
code_summary: Trains one independent MaskedSASRec per category: 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, learned positional embeddings, two bidirectional Transformer blocks with two heads, GELU output projection, and jointly learned item biases. Each sampled prefix produces a clean context with a final query mask and a separately corrupted reconstruction view whose final label is disabled. Both views share the same network and 256 uniform sampled negatives with target-collision masking. Loss weights are 0.5 final prediction and 0.5 historical reconstruction when auxiliary targets exist; otherwise only final prediction is used. AdamW, seed 42, validation checkpoint selection, patience 25, and a 200-epoch default are preserved. Prediction strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category and performs one forward pass, with all four routes and trial-local artifacts retained.
